requirements.requirement: The system must invoke the relevance scoring logic from EVAL-CT-REL-002 for each clinical trial returned by the clinical_trials_service.
The system must attach a normalized relevance_score field to every trial object in the service response.
The system must ensure the relevance_score value is within the expected normalized range defined in the schema from EVAL-CT-REL-001.
The system must preserve all existing clinical trial fields and structure when adding relevance scoring data.
The system must not break or alter existing filtering logic when relevance scoring is integrated.
The system must compute relevance scores using the user condition intent provided in the request context.
The system must pass each trial's condition data into the scoring logic without mutation or loss.
The system must include contributing factors or explanation metadata from the scoring logic in the enriched trial object if available.
The system must maintain response latency within acceptable service thresholds after adding relevance scoring.
The system must process relevance scoring deterministically for identical inputs within a single request lifecycle.
The system must handle trials with missing or empty condition data by assigning a default low or zero relevance score.
The system must continue returning trials even if relevance scoring fails for an individual trial, without failing the entire response.
The system must log scoring failures with sufficient diagnostic detail for debugging without exposing errors to the end user.
The system must ensure compatibility with downstream facade expectations by maintaining consistent field naming and types for relevance_score.
The system must support scoring for multiple trials in batch within a single request without cross-trial data leakage.
The system must ensure that relevance scoring does not reorder trials unless explicitly designed to do so in the service.
The system must correctly handle synonym and partial match outputs from the scoring logic without truncation or misrepresentation.
The system must gracefully handle absence of user condition intent by assigning neutral or default relevance scores to all trials.
